state:
**Goal `completion-files`, Stage 3 is green and Stage 4 has seven of its nine tests passing.** Hover and go-to-definition on a literal equal to a value are done (module docs of `hover.rs` and `definition.rs`).

The strict check is done. `diagnostics::for_document` now takes `&CompletionFiles`. The server passes the loaded set through `publish`, and the `.lspt` suite and `tests/actions.rs` pass an empty one. `unknown_values` in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/diagnostics.rs` warns with `W1020` (`W_COMPLETION_VALUE_UNKNOWN`) on a literal at a strict parameter whose text is none of the values that apply at the call. It skips a call where any attachment's `when` names an argument that is left out or is not one literal, and it checks only a `.nvs` entry file. The walk is `arguments::named_in_document`, which shares one literal walk with `in_document`. Its four tests are in `crates/nvs-lsp/tests/completion_file_values.rs`.

Not written yet: the Deprecated hint and its quick fix (the last two Stage 4 tests), the literal union (Stage 5) and the VS Code schema (Stage 6).

next.title: hover, go-to-definition, the strict check and the replacement

items.text: **The Deprecated hint and its quick fix** (`rule:ide/completion-files-offer-values-at-named-parameters` § *What else reads it*). Use the same walk as `unknown_values`, at `crates/nvs-lsp/src/diagnostics.rs:181`. Put a hint with the `Deprecated` tag on a literal equal to a deprecated value that applies at the call. `to_wire` sets no tags today (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/diagnostics.rs:270`), so the hint needs a way to carry one. Where the value names a `replacement`, attach a `Suggestion` that rewrites only the string, escaped for the literal's quote style. The item edit in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs` already escapes, so reuse it. `actions::at` (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/actions.rs:118`) reads only the compiler's `analysed.diags`, so it also needs `&CompletionFiles`, or the hint builder must be shared, for the fix to reach it. The hint probably needs a new W code (`W1021`) beside `W1020` in `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs`. Tests: `a_literal_equal_to_a_deprecated_value_gets_a_deprecated_hint` and `the_replacement_quick_fix_rewrites_only_the_string_and_escapes_for_its_quote`.

**Stage 5: a literal union completes its members**: `rule:ide/completion-offers-only-what-the-compiler-derived`. Read the parameter types the checker records on the resolved call (`param_tys`, used in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/arguments.rs:265`). Add items of kind `value`, merged with a completion file's values, in `crates/nvs-lsp/src/completion.rs`. Test: `a_string_argument_at_a_literal_union_parameter_offers_its_members`.

backlog: When a completion file is reloaded, the strict warnings in open documents stay stale until the next edit. `refresh_completion_files` (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/server.rs:1628`) publishes only the files' own findings. Owner: `diagnostics.rs` module doc, once this is decided.
Stage 6: `editors/vscode/schemas/completion-file.json` and the client's watcher and schema registration, the last of the goal's red checks.
